importDir.description: Folder scanned (recursively) for DiscordChatExporter JSON exports (`-f Json`). Relative paths resolve from the Shale project root; ~/ is supported.

syncEnabled.description: Run DiscordChatExporter on the discord-sync cron with the account connected on the Accounts page. Nothing is fetched until an account is connected. Automating a user account is against Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk.

syncScope.description: "all" syncs every server and DM the connected account can see; "selected" syncs only the channels, guilds, and (with includeDMs) DMs listed below.

dceCommand.description: Command that launches the DiscordChatExporter CLI. Empty uses the copy installed by `bun run setup discord` (data/discord/dce), then DiscordChatExporter.Cli on PATH.

tokenEnv.description: Fallback environment variable (e.g. in data/.env) for the Discord token, used only when no account is connected on the Accounts page. The token reaches the exporter via its environment, never the command line.

channels.description: Extra channel or thread ids to sync (with syncScope "selected", the only channels synced besides guilds and DMs).

guilds.description: Extra server (guild) ids whose channels are synced.

includeDMs.description: With syncScope "selected", also sync all direct messages and group DMs (always included with "all" for user tokens).

includeThreads.description: Which threads to include when syncing a guild or channel.

initialSyncDays.description: How far back the first sync of each channel reaches. 0 fetches the full history.

downloadMedia.description: Download attachments next to the exports (exportDir/media).

keepExports.description: Keep each sync's JSON files after ingestion instead of deleting them.

syncTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum run time for exporting one channel (with its threads).

gapMinutes.description: A silence longer than this starts a new conversation window (one searchable source per window).

maxWindowChars.description: Maximum transcript characters per window; keep at or below 12000 so whole windows stay searchable.

idleMinutes.description: The newest window of a conversation is indexed only after this much silence.

summarize.description: Summarise each window with the chat LLM; otherwise a heuristic summary is used.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for window summaries. Empty uses the default.

excludeBots.description: Leave bot messages out of transcripts.

namespace.description: Namespace for Discord sources and graph entities.
